learning_outcomes.text: Name and explain the basic concepts, elementary relationships and laws of optical technologies.
Demonstrate and apply the fundamental descriptive tools and analysis methods, especially in lighting technology, laser technology, and technical optics.
Name the most important areas of application.
Understand the practical significance of optical technologies and the developments driven by them.
Name, interpret, and design interacting light-generating and light-guiding components.
Enable the development of independent solutions in application areas of optical technologies.

syllabus_topics: Historical overview and current developments in optics
Definition of terms, quantities, units, laws, and standards
Spectral luminous efficiency and photometric radiation equivalent
Handling optical laboratory systems such as (fluorescence) microscopes, UV/Vis, infrared camera, polarization measurements etc.
Applications in measurement technology, production technology, material processing, biotechnology, and medical technology
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination. The grade's relevance for the final grade is determined according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
